name: Sushi
description: Vinegared rice with raw fish or vegetables — the rice is the part that takes years.

tcm.note: Cold vinegared rice with raw fish.

ayurveda.note: Matsya is ushna; the vinegar adds to it.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; served cold; the fish is garam, the rice thanda.

histamine.note: Raw fish plus vinegared rice held at room temperature — both matter, and freshness decides everything.

nutrition.highlight: the rice is the hard part
